title: GUDECA National Executive Committee
contactPolicy: Officers' personal telephone numbers are not published. Contact details belong to the people they identify, and each officer would have to agree before a number went online.
currencyNote: This roster is undated. Mr. Thadeus Fon was confirmed as General President at the GUDECA Europe meeting of 28 March 2026; the other offices may have changed since. If you know who holds them today, please tell us.
nameNote: The President's name is also written Thadeaus and Thaddeus; we use Thadeus, as in the 2026 Bonn minutes.
